explanation: Using `subprocess.call(["command", "-v", "srun"])` will fail on many systems because `command` is a shell built-in and not an executable, so `subprocess.call` (which does not use a shell by default) will raise `FileNotFoundError` on those systems, causing `srun_exists` to always be `False` and silently suppressing the srun-missing warning.
